subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Heterogeneous cross-cutting runtime support: MSVC CRT jmp_buf/setjmp-longjmp machinery, SEH unwind and exception-frame dispatch, critical-section and indirect-callback dispatch used by frame-path code, CRT-style float-to-string formatting and x87 float math helpers, locale resolution/caching with a static locale table, a system-time tick provider, and small byte/string scan helpers. Functions are grouped by shared callees, shared globals, and ABI shape; no packet function carries a proven owning object, so the only class with an evidenced shared layout is the jmp_buf record shared by the setjmp3/longjmp pair.

summary: Reconstruction of generic runtime objects from 33 validated function IR records. No packet function has a proven owner, so every grouping below is a proposal: MSVCJmpBuf is the one class with provable shared layout (the setjmp3 write side 0x0058A7EC and the longjmp read side 0x0058A770 operate on the same jmp_buf at identical offsets +0x0/+0x14/+0x18/+0x1C/+0x20/+0x24, including the signature cookie 1447244336). The remaining functions are grouped into ten interfaces by shared callees, shared globals, and ABI shape: SynchronizedIndirectDispatch (critical-section slot release + callback/indirect trampolines), MSVCCRTSehDispatch (SEH unwind/dispatch, MSVC C++ exception magic 0xE06D7363), CRTFloatToStringConversion (locale-aware number formatting with sign/width handling), CRTFloatMathHelpers (x87 exponentiation, rounding-mode, NaN/Inf and pow special cases), LocaleRuntime (resolution, enumeration callbacks, cached lookup over the shared 0x008D3F98 global block and 0x005E6D60 static table), LocaleStringParsing (hex parse + alphabetical count), StringScanHelpers, RenderArgsDispatch, SystemTimeTickProvider and StubRegistry. The two lock/unlock thunks 0x0058A323/0x0058A32A are mis-decoded frames and their exchange-and-invoke semantics are unresolved; the pow identification is DERIVED from structure, not confirmed.

function_roles.role: Trivial forwarder that releases synchronization lock slot index 13 by calling CritSectLeave and returns its result unchanged; the owning critical-section table and why callers sub_587AC0 and sub_589CC6 route through this indirection are unresolved.

Iterator that walks a contiguous array of void function pointers from a1 to end address a2 and invokes every non-null entry; called by sub_589C77 and sub_589CC6. The this:0x0 field is a spurious template artifact.
__cdecl indirect-call trampoline: calls the supplied function pointer a1 with no arguments and returns its result; the second parameter a2 is accepted but unused.

Atomically exchanges the return-address slot with v3 via _InterlockedExchange then invokes the swapped-out value as an indirect function pointer and returns its result. The frame is mis-decoded, so which real values flow through the exchange and the dispatch target are unresolved; reached from sub_5939F9 and SEHWrappedRenderDispatchCall.
Same atomic exchange-and-invoke shape as 0x0058A323 (frame mis-decoded); the jump-table dispatch interpretation rests only on the legacy ABI name and is not visible in the raw body.

SEH unwind handler (__userpurge): calls RtlUnwind to landing pad loc_58A359, clears UNWIND bit 0x02 from ExceptionRecord->ExceptionFlags, stores the current NtTib.ExceptionList into the caller's exception-registration pointer (this:0x0) and returns it.

Thin cdecl forwarding wrapper for the render path: invokes sub_593446(a1, a2[3], a3, 0, a2[2], a2[4], a2, 0) forwarding a1/a3 unchanged, reading dword array a2 elements at indices 2/3/4, and returns the callee's result unchanged.

Exception-frame dispatch helper: on ExceptionFlags & 0x66 it sets TargetFrame[9] to 1 and returns 1 (continue unwind); on the normal path it calls the per-frame handler sub_593446, then SEHUnwindHandler (0x0058A331) unless TargetFrame[9] was set by the handler, then calls the stored continuation at TargetFrame[6] and returns its result.

Magic-number dispatch check on a double-indirect pointer: dereferences a1 to an object (this:0x0), compares the object's first DWORD (obj:0x0) with magic -529697949 (0xE06D7363, the MSVC C++ exception signature); on match dispatches to an SEH wrapper handler (target not statically resolved), otherwise returns 0.

MSVC CRT longjmp over the jmp_buf at a1: reads the saved target (a1[0], this:0x0) and saved frame (a1[6], this:0x18); when the saved frame differs from FS:0 calls GlobalUnwind2; when the saved frame is non-null either runs the cookie-validated cleanup handler at a1[9] (this:0x24; cookie validated via EmptyStub_3d53 and a1[8]==1447244336 at this:0x20) or unwinds the SEH scope table via MSVCRTSEHFrameUnwinder(v3, a1[7], this:0x1C); then restores context via sub_58893A(a1[5], a1[0], 0) and jumps through a1[5] (this:0x14).

MSVC CRT __setjmp3: saves the non-volatile registers (EBP, EBX, EDI, ESI), stack pointer, return address, the current SEH exception list, and the jmp_buf signature 1447244336 into a5; records either the previous exception handler or a caller-supplied handler plus up to 6 trailing varargs dwords depending on the mode operand a6; returns 0.

Captures the current UTC system time via GetSystemTimeAsFileTime, folds the two 32-bit FILETIME halves into a 64-bit tick (Allmul shifting the high word by 0x100000000), stores the tick to global qword_8D3EC0 (upper dword overlapping 0x008D3EC4) and returns it; straight-line, no conditional branches.

Converts a double read through a1 into a sign/width-formatted string: formats it via LocaleAwareStringFormat, computes an adjusted width (adding 1 for a leading '-' character and for a positive a3), applies sign-aware width via sub_5955AA and final formatting via sub_58BE2E; returns the width argument a2.

Floating-point string formatter: optionally shifts the buffer (StringShiftByOffset), writes a leading '-' when the sign flag is 45, inserts the locale decimal separator byte_5E6BD8, advances past the mantissa (sub_58FCA0), writes exponent marker 'E', and decomposes the exponent value into hundreds/tens/units accumulated onto pre-initialized '0' characters; returns the original buffer pointer.

Formats a double read from a1 into a localized string and draws it with sign-aware position: converts via LocaleAwareStringFormat, advances the x position by one column when the sign flag is '-' (45), offsets y by the conversion result, draws via sub_58BF45; returns the original x position a2.

Formats a numeric value into output buffer a1: writes a leading '-' when the sign flag equals 45, shifts the buffer to make room, writes the locale decimal separator byte_5E6BD8, and zero-pads for negative exponent spans (sub_58BB10); handles a zero-value special case; returns the buffer start pointer.

Number-to-string helper (__cdecl): reads a double from a1, formats it via LocaleAwareStringFormat, routes through sub_5955AA into output buffer a2, and picks between an alternate conversion path (sub_58BE2E) and a truncation path before the final sub_58BF45 call.

Thin forwarder with no local computation: unconditionally tail-jumps to 0x58DC60 forwarding the current arguments and FPU state; the real float implementation at the jump target is outside this packet.

MSVC _matherr-style glue (__usercall): packs the incoming register and stack arguments into a small stack struct, forwards them to sub_596175(a2, v9, &a5), and returns the preserved x87 input value a4 (st0) unchanged.
Computes 2^a1 using x87 instructions: frndint isolates the integer part, F2XM1 evaluates the fractional-power part (with +1.0), and FSCALE combines into 2^a1, returned on the x87 stack (st0).
Empty function: the body contains only a null statement with no reads, writes, calls, fields, globals, guards or callees; reachable from three call sites but performs no work.

Float-conversion rounding helper: when the 0x80000 x87 status bit is clear returns the in-register float value plus 1.0 (the literal folded from global dbl_5B8E00); returns the value unchanged when the bit is set.

Loads an 8-byte double from the pointer argument a2 (fields this+0x0 and this+0x4); when the exponent bits (a2[1] & 0x7FF00000) are not all set the finite double is returned unchanged; when the exponent is all ones (Inf/NaN) the 64-bit pattern is left-shifted by 11 and returned as the result double; a1 is unused.

Extracts the IEEE-754 exponent field from a float/double bit pattern a2 as a2 & 0x7FF00000, except when the exponent field is all ones (NaN/Infinity) in which case the full pattern a2 is returned unchanged; the first parameter a1 is unused.

CRT special-case classifier for a binary double operation (structure matches pow special cases): classifies a1 (NaN/+inf/-inf/1.0) and a2 (NaN/+inf/-inf/0.0/1.0) and writes one of the result constants dbl_5E7718/5E7720/5E7738 or the literals 1.0/0.0 to *a3, returning a flag that marks the exact |a1|==1.0 result.
Stub with no parameters, fields, globals, guards or callees that always returns the integer constant 0 with no side effects; the intent behind returning 0 to each caller is not established.

Character-set first-match helper: builds a 32-byte (256-bit) membership bitset from every byte of string a2, then scans string a1 and returns the index of the first character whose bit is set; returns the a1 null-terminator length when no character matches.

Locale enumeration callback: parses a hex locale string via HexStringToIntParser, queries locale info through the function pointer dword_8D3FB8, compares the current language string (dword_8D3FA8) and on match (subject to three-letter flag dword_8D3FA4, charset-mode dword_8D3FA0, and sub_59045F validation) commits the validated locale ID into dword_8D3FB4 and Locale (0x008D3F98) with validation flag bit 2 set in dword_8D3FB0; returns ((~dword_8D3FB0 >> 2) & 1), or clears dword_8D3FB0 and returns 1 when the info query fails.

__stdcall callback that parses a locale ID string via HexStringToIntParser, queries locale information through dword_8D3FB8, compares the returned region string against dword_8D3FAC via sub_588410, and on match with a passing ShortInRangeCheckAgainstStaticTable (sub_590440) sets dword_8D3FB0 |= 4, records the ID in dword_8D3FB4 and Locale, and returns the flag bit test; on a failed query it clears dword_8D3FB0 and returns 1.

Locale resolver: sets flag bits 0x104 on dword_8D3FB0, calls the Win32 GetUserDefaultLCID API, stores the returned locale ID into both dword_8D3FB4 and the Locale global (0x008D3F98), and returns the same value.

Locale info lookup with a cached table: binary-searches a static table of locale IDs (dword_5E6D60, 11 dwords per entry) for the requested Locale; when found returns one of several per-entry cached strings selected by LCType (1, 3, 7, 0xB, 0x1001, 0x1002, 0x1004), copies it via sub_587DD0 with a cchData-1 length limit, NUL-terminates and returns 1; any miss falls back to the Win32 GetLocaleInfoA API.

Parses a NUL-terminated hex digit string into an integer by ASCII-normalized base-16 accumulation (letters 'a'-'f'/'A'-'F' normalized, decimal digits unchanged); used by the locale enumeration callbacks and three sibling parser helpers in the same module.
Scans the input string a1 from its start and counts the leading run of ASCII letters (A-Z 65..90, a-z 97..122) before the first non-letter character, returning that count.

classes.name: MSVCJmpBuf
classes.responsibility: MSVC CRT jmp_buf record shared by the __setjmp3 write side (0x0058A7EC) and the longjmp read side (0x0058A770). Both functions operate on the identical layout at identical offsets: saved register/target state at +0x0, final jump slot at +0x14, saved SEH exception-registration frame at +0x18, saved trylevel at +0x1C, signature cookie at +0x20 (validated against 1447244336), and optional cleanup handler at +0x24.

state_machines.name: LocaleValidationState
states: unresolved (validation flags dword_8D3FB0 clean, no locale committed)
user_default_resolved (GetUserDefaultLocale set 0x104 flag bits and stored the LCID into Locale)
matched_committed (an enumeration callback matched and set bit 2 of dword_8D3FB0, storing the validated ID into dword_8D3FB4 and Locale)
query_failed (a locale-info query failed; the callback cleared dword_8D3FB0 and returned 1)
state_machines.transitions: The locale enumeration callbacks commit the resolved ID by setting dword_8D3FB0 |= 4 and storing into dword_8D3FB4 and Locale (0x008D3F98); each callback returns ((~dword_8D3FB0 >> 2) & 1) which gates enumeration continuation. GetUserDefaultLocale marks the state with the 0x104 flag bits and stores the LCID. The transitions into and out of these flag states are driven by callers outside this packet.

state_machines.name: SEHUnwindDispatchState
states: normal_path (ExceptionFlags & 0x66 == 0: run per-frame handler sub_593446, then SEHUnwindHandler unless TargetFrame[9] was set, then call the continuation at TargetFrame[6])
unwind_path (ExceptionFlags & 0x66 != 0: set TargetFrame[9] to 1 and return 1 to continue the unwind pass)
state_machines.transitions: The 0x66 unwinding bitmask in ExceptionRecord->ExceptionFlags selects the unwind path; the TargetFrame[9] slot records unwind-in-progress and, after the per-frame handler, decides whether SEHUnwindHandler runs.

interfaces.name: SynchronizedIndirectDispatch
interfaces.purpose: Critical-section and indirect-call dispatch primitives used by frame-path callers: releases critical-section lock slot index 13 via CritSectLeave (0x0058E04B), iterates an array of function pointers invoking non-null entries, provides a no-argument indirect-call trampoline, and two atomic lock/unlock-around-indirect-call thunks (_InterlockedExchange of the return-address slot followed by an indirect call). The two atomic thunks are mis-decoded frames and their real semantics are unresolved.

interfaces.name: MSVCCRTSehDispatch
interfaces.purpose: MSVC CRT structured-exception handling helpers: an SEH unwind-with-cleanup handler (RtlUnwind to landing pad 0x0058A359, UNWIND-bit 0x02 clear, exception-list repoint), an exception-frame dispatcher that branches on ExceptionFlags & 0x66 and routes through the per-frame handler sub_593446 and the SEH unwind handler, and a magic-number dispatch that double-dereferences an object and compares its first DWORD to the MSVC C++ exception signature 0xE06D7363.

interfaces.name: CRTFloatToStringConversion
interfaces.purpose: Locale-aware number-to-string conversion: formats doubles into buffers with sign/width handling (ASCII '-' code 45), locale decimal-separator insertion (byte_5E6BD8), zero padding for negative exponent spans, exponent 'E' decomposition, truncation, and sign-aware draw-position adjustment. The functions share the formatter LocaleAwareStringFormat (0x00595621), the conversion helpers sub_5955AA, sub_58BE2E and sub_58BF45, StringShiftByOffset (0x0058C0D0) and the exponent template global 0x005B8D80.

interfaces.name: CRTFloatMathHelpers
interfaces.purpose: x87/CRT floating-point math helpers: a passthrough tail-jump to the real float implementation, an MSVC _matherr-style error-handler glue, 2^x exponentiation (frndint + F2XM1 + FSCALE), rounding-mode selection from the x87 status word bit 0x80000, double loads with NaN/Inf exponent masking and a left-shift-by-11 transform, exponent-field extraction with an all-ones guard, and a pow special-case classifier using result constants dbl_5E7718/5E7720/5E7738.

interfaces.name: LocaleRuntime
interfaces.purpose: Locale resolution and lookup: Windows enumeration callbacks that parse locale IDs, query locale information through the function pointer dword_8D3FB8, and commit matched IDs into the Locale global (0x008D3F98) with validation flags dword_8D3FB0 bit 2; the user-default-locale resolver (GetUserDefaultLCID); and a cached locale-info lookup that binary-searches a static table (0x005E6D60) with a GetLocaleInfoA fallback.

interfaces.name: LocaleStringParsing
interfaces.purpose: String parsing helpers used by locale validation: hex-string to integer parsing (ASCII-normalized base-16 accumulation) and leading-alphabetical-character counting.

interfaces.name: StringScanHelpers
interfaces.purpose: Generic byte-string scanning: builds a 256-bit membership set from one string and returns the index of the first character of another string that appears in the set (or the null-terminator length when nothing matches).

interfaces.name: RenderArgsDispatch
interfaces.purpose: Render-subsystem argument forwarding: builds a call to the render handler sub_593446 from a caller-supplied dword array (elements 2, 3 and 4) plus the array pointer itself and two literal-zero arguments, returning the handler result unchanged.

interfaces.name: SystemTimeTickProvider
interfaces.purpose: Captures the current UTC system time as a FILETIME and folds its two 32-bit halves into a single 64-bit tick value stored to global qword_8D3EC0 and returned as the function result.

interfaces.name: StubRegistry
interfaces.purpose: No-op and constant-return stub entry points reachable from several callers: 0x0058DCB5 performs no work at all and 0x0058FB7E always returns integer 0. Whether they are placeholders for unimplemented behavior or deliberate no-ops is unresolved.

compatibility_contracts.name: MSVCJmpBufLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: The jmp_buf record consumed by the setjmp3/longjmp pair carries the saved register/target state at +0x0, the final jump slot at +0x14, the saved SEH exception-registration frame at +0x18, the saved trylevel at +0x1C, the signature cookie 1447244336 at +0x20, and an optional cleanup handler at +0x24. A replacement must write this layout in __setjmp3 and consume it in longjmp, including validating the cookie before invoking the stored cleanup handler and unwinding the SEH scope table to the saved trylevel.

compatibility_contracts.name: CriticalSectionSlotReleaseContract
compatibility_contracts.description: ReleaseLockByIndex releases critical-section lock slot index 13 via CritSectLeave and propagates its result unchanged; callers sub_587AC0 and sub_589CC6 depend on the slot being released when control returns.

compatibility_contracts.name: MSVCCppExceptionMagicDispatchContract
compatibility_contracts.description: StreamMagicNumberCheck dereferences a1 once to an object pointer (this:0x0) and compares the object's first DWORD (obj:0x0) with magic -529697949 (0xE06D7363), the MSVC C++ exception signature; on equality it dispatches to an SEH wrapper handler, otherwise it returns 0.

compatibility_contracts.name: LocaleStateGlobalsContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The locale runtime keeps its resolved state in a compact global block: Locale at 0x008D3F98, region flag at 0x008D3F9C, charset-mode at 0x008D3FA0, three-letter flag at 0x008D3FA4, current language string pointer at 0x008D3FA8, region string pointer at 0x008D3FAC, validation flags at 0x008D3FB0 (bit 2 = matched/committed, 0x104 = user-default resolved), resolved locale ID at 0x008D3FB4, and the locale-info function pointer at 0x008D3FB8. The enumeration callbacks commit by setting bit 2 and storing the ID; GetUserDefaultLocale stores the LCID and sets the 0x104 bits.

compatibility_contracts.name: LocaleInfoCacheTableContract
compatibility_contracts.description: GetLocaleInfoCached binary-searches a static locale table whose entries are 11 dwords wide starting at dword_5E6D60, with per-LCType cached string columns (LCType 1, 3, 7, 0xB, 0x1001, 0x1002, 0x1004), a hard-coded table bound of 26 entries, and a GetLocaleInfoA fallback on any miss. A replacement must preserve the column-to-LCType mapping, the length-limited copy via sub_587DD0, and the fallback.

compatibility_contracts.name: FloatFormattingOutputContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The float-to-string family formats doubles using the locale decimal separator byte at 0x005E6BD8, treats ASCII '-' (code 45) as the negative-sign marker for width and draw-position adjustment, emits the exponent marker 'E' (69), and writes exponent digits onto pre-initialized '0' characters; the shared scratch record carries the sign flag at offset 0, a digit-count/width quantity at offset 1, and exponent/leading-digit state at offset 2. A replacement must reproduce these output conventions for the CRT float conversion callers, including the CfltcvtCRTFloatConversionDispatch stage entry at 0x0058C07F.

compatibility_contracts.name: PowSpecialCaseResultContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The pow special-case classifier writes one of three result constants to *a3 depending on the base/exponent special cases: dbl_5E7718 (the +infinity / greater-than-1.0 family result), dbl_5E7720 (the exact |base| == 1.0 result, returned with flag 1), and dbl_5E7738 (the odd-integer negative-infinity result); the literal 1.0/0.0 complete the result set, and the function returns a flag marking the |base| == 1.0 case. A replacement must keep the same special-case result selection and return-flag contract.

compatibility_contracts.name: SystemTimeTickGlobalContract
compatibility_contracts.description: GetSystemTimeAsFileTimeTo64BitTick stores a FILETIME-derived 64-bit tick into global qword_8D3EC0 (its upper dword covering 0x008D3EC4) and returns the same value; any consumer of qword_8D3EC0 depends on this write being performed with the combined 64-bit value.

unresolved: 0x0058A323 / 0x0058A32A (atomic lock/unlock thunks): both frames are mis-decoded ('positive sp value has been detected'), so which real values flow through the _InterlockedExchange of the return-address slot and through the indirect call is unresolved; the legacy jump-table interpretation for 0x0058A32A rests only on the ABI name and is not visible in the raw body.

MSVCJmpBuf: the literal 1447244336 at +0x20 is the deterministic cookie guard value; its textual meaning is not decoded and it was preserved as a decimal literal per the packet. The a2 parameter of crtLongjmp appears nowhere in the body and is unaccounted for; the mode operand a6 and dual-role a8 of __setjmp3 are only partially inferred.

0x0058A770 (crtLongjmp): the a1[8] cookie comparison consumer side (which code validates the cookie at setjmp time) is not visible in the packet; the setjmp/longjmp contract at the three callers is not established.

field:this:0x00000000 is a spurious template-generated field on the __cdecl helpers callAllNonNullCallbacks (0x00589D7D) and FormatDoubleWithTruncation (0x0058BFEC); both have no `this` in their raw source, and the packet field list is misattributed for 0x0058BFEC.

0x0058A6D5 (StreamMagicNumberCheck): the SEH wrapper dispatch target is not present as a callee in the packet and is source-backed only; obj:0x0 and this:0x0 alias at the same offset because of the double dereference.

LocaleRuntime: the 0xF002/0xF005 flag masks and the +4097/+4098 info-query subtypes are only inferable from the locale-info API contract, not from this packet; the function pointer dword_8D3FB8 and region pointer dword_8D3FAC identities are defined elsewhere; the writers of dword_8D3FA0/dword_8D3FA4 are not visible here.

0x005904F7 (GetLocaleInfoCached): the 11-dwords-per-entry table layout is evidenced only through indexing arithmetic, not by a struct definition; the table bound (v5=26) is a hard-coded count with no evidenced table-length symbol.

0x0058DE2C (PowSpecialCaseClassifier): the identification as pow special-case handling is DERIVED from the classification structure, not confirmed by packet evidence; globals dbl_5B8C80 and dbl_5B8CC8 are read but absent from the pseudocode (presumed folded comparison constants); the FPU sign flag v6 producer is unknown.

0x0058B59F: two TLS bytes at 0xFF00000000005394 and 0xFF00000000005395 are listed as read but do not appear in the raw body; their role is unknown. GetSystemTimeAsFileTime is an IAT import pointer whose module binding is not reconstructed.

0x0058DC40 (CRTFloatPassthroughWrapper): the real implementation at jump target 0x58DC60 is outside this packet, so the actual float operation is unknown; the caller at 0x0058DD89 is not in the allowed evidence set.
0x0058DCE5 (FloadWithFBFloatLoadWithNaNCheck): the purpose of the left-shift-by-11 transform for Inf/NaN inputs is unknown; the a1 argument is unused and its caller-side role is unresolved.

0x0058BE2E (sub_58BE2E): the struct at a4 (exponent value at +4, leading-digit flag at +12, sign flag at +0) is only partially characterized and its owning type is unknown; buffer chars at v6[1..4] are assumed pre-initialized '0' by the caller; global aE000 (0x005B8D80) appears in the index as the exponent template but is not referenced in the body.

0x0058A40A (RenderArgsDispatch): the semantics of the two literal-zero arguments and of the a2 element slots (indices 2/3/4) are not evident from this wrapper alone; the behavior and prototype of sub_593446 are unknown at this layer.

StubRegistry (0x0058DCB5 / 0x0058FB7E): whether the empty/constant-0 bodies are placeholders or deliberate no-ops cannot be determined from the packet; the ABI names carry LEGACY trust and are not runtime-confirmed.

X87FPExponentiation (0x0058DCA0): the frndint rounding mode is assumed round-to-nearest and is not fixed by the source; whether the helper is shared math infrastructure or subsystem-specific is unknown.
GetUserDefaultLocale (0x005903C0): the meaning of the 0x104 flag bits and the distinction between the Locale global and dword_8D3FB4 are not established from this packet.

General: the interface groupings for CRTFloatMathHelpers, StringScanHelpers, RenderArgsDispatch and StubRegistry are GUESS proposals from ABI shape and shared callees; no packet evidence proves a common owning object, and equal byte offsets across different functions are not treated as shared fields except for the jmp_buf layout proven by the setjmp3/longjmp pair.

No evidence in the packet establishes runtime truth; every class and interface here is a DERIVED or GUESS proposal and must not be promoted to CONFIRMED or FACT without independent static or runtime evidence.
